Nikki Tamboli and Arbaz Patel’s relationship has once again come under the spotlight. The couple, who had been open about their relationship after meeting on Bigg Boss Marathi 5, are now facing breakup speculation after their social media activity caught fans’ attention.
The rumours gained momentum after Nikki and Arbaz appeared to unfollow each other on Instagram. Around the same time, both began sharing cryptic messages on social media, leaving fans wondering if something had gone wrong between them.

Amid the speculation, Nikki has now shared two posts that have added further fuel to the rumours. One of them reads, “My relationship status, I’m single but there’s a man who’s not my man but because of him, there’s no other man.”

In another post, the actress wrote, “Dil hi toa tha.. Tod dia..”

This was Selena Gomez’s Stars Dance era in 2013, when she leaned heavily into Indian-inspired visuals and choreography for “Come & Get It.” 

The song itself incorporates bhangra-inspired elements, and her performances featured Indian-influenced costumes, dance movements, jewelry and the bindi she wore on her forehead. She performed the song with similar styling at major appearances including the MTV Movie Awards and Billboard Music Awards.

The aesthetic also sparked controversy at the time. Some Hindu groups criticized Gomez for wearing the bindi primarily as a fashion accessory rather than respecting its cultural and religious significance, while Gomez said she had studied aspects of the culture and described her interest in Hinduism and Indian culture positively. 

“Come & Get It” ultimately became one of the defining hits of that stage of her career, reaching the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100.
